about: A feed reader for the terminal that saves articles as Markdown.

prs.title: Blogger posts open the post, not the comments feed
prs.broken: Posts from Blogger feeds used the comments feed as their link, so opening one in the browser showed a page of raw feed data.
prs.changed: The reader now picks the link that points to the post itself, and falls back to the first link as before.
prs.matters: Posts from Blogger sites open as normal web pages.
